quality_effect: Adds time-stamped survey epoch and geoid controls so candidate elevation is not mixed across incompatible survey vintages.

official_sources.name: EA LIDAR DTM Time Stamped Tiles

verified_facts: Archive contains site-specific DTM surveys since 1998
DTM contains terrain surface after object removal
Downloads are GeoTIFF rasters in 5km zip files
Vertical datum is Ordnance Datum Newlyn
Data is aligned to OS Grid
Survey transformation is specific to the survey time period
Metadata catalogue identifies dates resolution transformation and geoidal model
